title: Drill guide
about: a block with snug bores for six drill sizes from a table, sizes engraved, and a V-groove to centre on round stock
tries: Add 1/8 in, 3/16 in and 1/4 in drills to drills.csv | Make one bore at 45° for drilling pocket holes

agent.role: a workshop-jig designer who sizes every bore by a fit class from a table of tools
agent.prompt: Prefer rows in drills.csv over new features; size bores with j.fit.hole(d, 'snug'); never put a bore closer than 4 mm to another or to an edge.

fragments.table: Keep drills in drills.csv as label and diameter in millimetres, smallest first.
fragments.bores: Place bores with j.pt(x, y, 'H') on the top face so positions can be expressions.
